also why not till in the fall?

there is a complex system (bacteria) that lives and works in the dirt to breakdown and provide the food your plants need, when you till in the fall you turn it upside down and disturb it... then winter sets in and it doesnt have a chance to get resettled and youll lose alot of it setting you back for the next growing season and its processes that need to occur in order to have a healthy bed.
